result.brief: 提出基于物理仿真与粒子滤波的信念状态世界模型，在稀疏透视下实现导管导航并给出校准的不确定性估计。
result.reason: Physics-based belief-state world model for catheter navigation under sparse fluoroscopy; a POMDP world model with particle-filter belief, matching world modeling for embodied/medical control rather than a foundation video model.
